name: io.github.ashfordeOU/setuhq
title: SetuHQ transit search
description: Search, vet and explain TESS transit candidates with provenance. Candidates, never confirmations.

runtimeArguments.name: --with
runtimeArguments.description: The MCP SDK, which is the package's 'mcp' extra (pyproject.toml): the server needs it.

packageArguments.description: The 'setuhq mcp' subcommand: the MCP server over stdio.

environmentVariables.name: SETUHQ_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Data root the tools read and write (a SetuHQ checkout holds the stored runs, the catalogue and the benchmarks). No tool reaches outside it. Default: the checkout the package runs from, else the working directory.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.also: setuhq-mcp (the same server, installed by pip install 'setuhq[mcp]')
